answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing tasks that peers later verify, with a small stake locked until the work is accepted. A new identity starts with no verified history, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply influence; each account must independently spend time and stake to build trust. Reviewers can compare linked submissions, including a shale analysis routed through an onyx tool at the harbor, and reject duplicates. The attacker pays repeated deposits and labor, while honest agents gain reputation through useful work.
